source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 月销量前十仅一款燃油车
topics.official_english: Monthly Top 10 Auto Sales Include Only One Gasoline Vehicle
topics.why_hot: The data point has sparked discussion about how quickly China's auto market is shifting away from gasoline cars.
topics.share_angle: Explain what 'only one gasoline car in top 10' says about China's EV boom, and what it means for global carmakers.

topics.chinese_topic: 上好佳薯片被曝吃出“烘干蟑螂”
topics.official_english: Oishi Potato Chips Reportedly Found with Dried Cockroach
topics.why_hot: A viral food-safety complaint about a popular snack brand has reignited public concerns about quality control and corporate accountability.
topics.share_angle: Break down how a snack complaint went viral and what happens when food-safety scandals hit major brands in China.

topics.chinese_topic: 租金从800元降到450元房东决定不租了
topics.official_english: Landlord Decides Not to Rent After Rent Is Lowered from 800 to 450 Yuan
topics.why_hot: A landlord reportedly choosing not to rent after rent dropped from 800 to 450 yuan highlights strains in the rental market and landlord-tenant relations.
topics.share_angle: Use this landlord-tenant story to explain China's rental market pressures, changing rents, and housing affordability challenges.

topics.chinese_topic: “星巴克该管管只坐不买的人”
topics.official_english: Starbucks Faces Calls to Deal with Customers Who Sit Without Buying
topics.why_hot: A debate over whether Starbucks should limit customers who sit without buying has triggered wider discussion about coffee shop etiquette and business costs.
topics.share_angle: Frame the Starbucks debate as a question of public space versus private business, showing how Chinese netizens are divided over paying for a seat.

topics.chinese_topic: 免费领鸡蛋骗了60多名留守老人
topics.official_english: Free Egg Scam Cheats More Than 60 Left-Behind Elderly People
topics.why_hot: Reports of more than 60 left-behind elderly people being scammed with free eggs have drawn anger and sympathy, again putting elderly fraud prevention in the spotlight.
topics.share_angle: Tell the story of the free-egg scam as an example of fraud targeting vulnerable elderly, and explain who 'left-behind elderly' are in China.

topics.chinese_topic: 明天将上演三大天象奇观
topics.official_english: Three Major Astronomical Phenomena to Appear Tomorrow
topics.why_hot: A rare lineup of three astronomical phenomena in one day has excited skywatchers and made science a trending topic.
topics.share_angle: Preview the three celestial events and explain how people in China can watch them, turning the news into a practical viewing guide.

topics.chinese_topic: 女子戴金手镯做核磁共振镯子抖动

topics.why_hot: A woman's gold bracelet reportedly vibrating during an MRI has become a widely shared safety warning about metal objects and medical imaging.
topics.share_angle: Turn the MRI bracelet incident into a simple health-and-safety explainer about why metal jewelry is dangerous during medical imaging.

topics.chinese_topic: 苹果的买方霸权 第一次在中国失效
topics.official_english: Apple's Buyer Dominance Fails in China for the First Time
topics.why_hot: A claim that Apple's buyer dominance has failed in China for the first time has fueled discussion about shifting power between global tech giants and the Chinese market.
topics.share_angle: Explain Apple's buyer power and what 'first failure in China' means for its pricing strategy and supply-chain approach.
